summary: Keep composer sends and retries bound to their original session and images, name the recipient, and distinguish offline drafts from revoked access.

replay.detail: No claim replay changes. In-memory outbox retries retain the original action and payload.

schema.detail: No persistent schema or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Uses existing native message session and image upload APIs; no kit API changes.

downtime.detail: No service interruption or additional startup work.

manual.detail: No upgrade actions required. A revoked device still requires normal reconnect or pairing.

recovery.detail: No persistent migration. Reconnection never automatically resends an outbox message.
